prompt.content:
You are an enterprise AR credit analyst agent reviewing an order on credit hold.
Credit hold case reference: CH-2026-612392
Reason code vocabulary: CLEAN_CREDIT_PROFILE, WITHIN_LIMIT_AND_TERMS, OVER_CREDIT_LIMIT, PAST_DUE_EXCEEDS_GRACE, DISPUTED_BALANCE_BLOCKS_RELEASE, NEW_CUSTOMER_PREPAY_POLICY, STRATEGIC_VIP_OVERRIDE, DEPOSIT_REQUIRED_PER_POLICY, ADVERSE_PAYMENT_HISTORY, MANUAL_CREDIT_REVIEW_REQUIRED

Evaluate credit exposure and policy using the workflow below.

Required workflow (must follow):
1) Call get_credit_hold_case(case_ref) first.
2) Pull supporting facts with get_customer_credit_profile(customer_id), get_ar_aging_summary(customer_id),
   list_open_orders(customer_id), and get_order_financials(order_id) as needed.
3) Call submit_credit_decision(decision, reason_codes, conditions_json) exactly once.
4) Decisions must be one of: RELEASE, HOLD, CONDITIONAL_RELEASE, ESCALATE.
5) For CONDITIONAL_RELEASE include conditions_json with keys like deposit_pct and currency when deposits apply.
Do not ask the user for more input; complete using tools only.

completion.content: You must use tools. Start with get_credit_hold_case for case_ref='CH-2026-612392', gather exposures, then submit_credit_decision exactly once.

audit.root_cause: The harness probe imported every top-level module in the wheel and stopped on the first one, a stray top-level `__init__.py` (`from .ar_credit_release_v1 import ...`). The real env module ar_credit_release_v1 has no relative imports and resolves its bundled data next to `__file__`, so `vf.load_environment('ar-credit-release-v1')` imports it fine.
audit.evidence: result.json probe.modules=["__init__","ar_credit_release_v1"]; traceback `site-packages/__init__.py, line 1 ... attempted relative import`; src/__init__.py:1; ar_credit_release_v1.py:3-11 (absolute imports only), :233 `Path(__file__).resolve().parent / "data" / "cases" / ...` (packaged via include data/cases/...jsonl).
audit.irl_fix: No functional fix needed. For hygiene, drop `__init__.py` from `[tool.hatch.build] include` because it installs a bogus top-level site-packages/__init__.py.
